correctness.rationale: The finite generator drift and quadratic action give exact stationary mean/variance. The mean autocovariance is exactly one exponential, while fresh binomial detection modifies its scale and the zero-lag variance in a distinguishable way. Two lags recover decay rate and latent covariance scale; the mean/variance recover detection. Positive source/target switching and recruitment are equivalent to \(L<N<U\), with explicit one-to-one reconstruction at each feasible integer. The exact examples and 1,100 independently constructed detailed-balance distributions were rechecked; numerical and finite tests are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: In a natural behavioral recruitment process, unknown population size, imitation and imperfect detection are materially confounded. The exact feasible integer interval discriminates informative from intrinsically uninformative experimental designs; it supplies singleton and unbounded counterexamples, and shows why observing more two-time covariances is insufficient. The precise all-positive-parameter converse and tight boundary are useful for research design and interpretation, rather than a synthetic arbitrary invariant.
